top_signals.title: Pacific Leaders Criticize China’s Recent Missile Test
top_signals.summary: The leaders of Pacific island nations took a thinly-veiled swipe at China’s recent missile test in their region, an unexpected move after earlier failed attempts to agree on a response.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Malaysia Johor Regent TMJ’s Plan to Sell Singapore Land Clouded by Huge Tax Bill
top_signals.summary: A Malaysian royal’s plan to sell a tract of land in the heart of Singapore faces a complication: a tax bill that may exceed $1 billion.

top_signals.title: Three crew members of missing fishing boat found dead off of Miyazaki Prefecture
top_signals.summary: As the fishing boat has not been located, authorities are continuing the search, including deploying aircraft, while investigating the cause of the incident.

top_signals.summary: Ohtani has been plagued by right biceps pain and left knee issues. The knee soreness has prevented him from pitching since July 3.
